purpose: Teach: ブラインド/逃避/有志/無人/調味/繁盛/ドリル/箱根

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、窓のブラインド、新しく、変えたんだ、私の部屋、お洒落になったよ、見て。
lines.en: Aoi, I changed the window blinds in my room — look how much nicer it looks now.
lines.style: Bright and eager. Leans forward slightly, eyes light up on 'look'. Quick pace, open delivery. Wants her to see what she's done.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。最近、仕事から、現実逃避したくなる時、あるよね、メイちゃん、わかる?
lines.en: Yeah. I know exactly what you mean — lately at work I keep just wanting to escape from it all.
lines.style: Soft, almost confessional. Settles back slightly. Slower tempo, genuine. The vulnerability of admitting something true to someone she trusts.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 子供食堂、有志で、運営しているの、知ってた、葵?素敵な活動よね、本当に。
lines.en: Did you know about that, Aoi? The kids' cafeteria you're helping run — it's such a beautiful thing, really.
lines.style: Animated and warm. Slight rise on 'know' with genuine admiration. Energetic but sincere, not performative. Naturally expressive.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 駅、最近、無人化、進んでるよね、改札、機械ばかりで、ちょっと、寂しい。
lines.en: The stations have been going unmanned lately, haven't they? All these automatic gates... it feels a little lonely somehow.
lines.style: Wistful, almost faraway tone. Soft delivery on 'lonely.' Slight pause before the final word, as if noticing the feeling as she says it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 新しい調味料、レシピに、加えたら、料理の幅、広がったの、私、はまってる、最近。
lines.en: I've been experimenting with new spices in my cooking and it's opened up so many possibilities — I'm really into it lately.
lines.style: Animated and engaged. Quick, enthusiastic delivery. Moves through the thought with momentum. The pleasure of discovery in her voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 駅前の蕎麦屋、最近、繁盛してるよ、行列、毎日、できてるみたいよ、お昼時。
lines.en: That soba restaurant near the station's been packed lately — there's a line every day at lunch time.
lines.style: Light observation, conversational. Steady pace. Not invested, but noticing. The tone of someone sharing small truths about the world.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: DIYのドリル、お父さんに、借りたわよ、棚、作ってみるんだ、楽しみ、最近の趣味。
lines.en: I borrowed my dad's drill — I'm going to try building a shelf. It's become my hobby lately and I'm really looking forward to it.
lines.style: Eager and focused. Lift on 'borrowed' and 'building.' Quick tempo, genuine excitement. The anticipation of someone who's discovered something that engages her.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 今度の休み、箱根温泉、行こうって、決めたよ、葵と二人で、楽しみだね、本当に。
lines.en: I've decided — next time I have a day off, the two of us are going to Hakone for a hot spring. It's going to be so much fun.
lines.style: Warm anticipation. Gentle conviction on 'decided.' Slight rise toward the end. Tender — like she's already imagining it. The pleasure of planning something with someone she cares about.
